description: Prepare the current account's automatic property outline and interpreted design brief WITHOUT starting a generation job, reserving or consuming design credits, confirming a review, sharing contacts or opening checkout. Use this operation whenever a homeowner or Pro asks to preview before Generate; do not use design_yard for a preview-only request because it can reuse an already confirmed review and start a job. First verify the intended account with get_account, find the residential property with find_property, and choose a style from list_styles. Preparation may fetch imagery and detect an outline under its existing preparation limits. Pass the exact returned property_ref and confirmed address when available. Then call get_design_review with the returned review_id/revision and persona to display the frozen outline, image and brief; if preparing, read it again later. Homeowners approve the best automatic estimate without drawing or editing. Viewing or preparing never grants approval. Do not automatically invoke design_yard after preparation, including when state is confirmed. A later separate user approval is required; use get_continuation_link only if the user wants an optional app/site continuation.
name: prepare_design_review
title: Prepare Property Preview
